conviction_note: The company-level arithmetic points to a FY2026 guide cut: $150-180M needs at least $114M in H2 against a $20.2M Q2, and there has been no order release since the August 6 call. But the stock is down 47% since that print and 20% in 5 days, sits about 10% above its 52-week low, and has 38.9M shares short (6.3 days to cover). So a cut is largely priced and a 'less bad' outcome can squeeze it. p_up 46 x abs 14 gives -1.1. The findings sum to -2.7 because each finding is sized on its own (the guide cut at -2.5 against +3.5 of positioning offsets plus many small negatives); the scaled number is smaller because I think the price already holds most of the cut.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $38.8M, EPS -$0.20 with a -$0.23 whisper (Earnings Whispers preview 2026-11-10, https://finviz.com/news/420290/red-cat-needs-a-near-doubling-of-revenue-to-prove-its-back-half-bet-is-real). The other sources agree within 5%: $40.3M / EPS -$0.21 (chartmill, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/1RCAT.MI/estimates) and $40.7M / -$0.20, Q4 $73.6M (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/RCAT/earnings-forecasts). Company guide: FY2026 revenue $150-180M, reaffirmed 2026-08-06 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/red-cat-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-07/). FY street about $157M, at the low end of the guide. The stock trades on the FY guide more than on the quarter.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest via equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/rcat/shortinterest): 37.6M shares (5.71 days to cover) at the 2026-10-15 settlement and 38.9M (6.32 days) at 2026-10-30. That is about 25% of the 152.7M shares outstanding (10-Q cover), rising, and a crowded short. Baseline options: 25-delta skew +7.41 vol points (downside paid), event-implied move 10.32%, straddle 14.64% to the 11-20 expiry, put/call OI 0.70. So the options market leans down and the short base is crowded: a guide cut agrees with the skew, and a 'less bad' guide meets a short squeeze.

next_guide.company_current_guide: FY2026 revenue $150-180M, reaffirmed 2026-08-06 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/red-cat-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-07/). No quarterly guide. Gross margin about 30% exit rate by year-end.
next_guide.basis: The FY guide needs at least $114M in H2 after a $35.7M H1 ($20.2M Q2). Not one order release has followed the Aug 6 call (IR press-release list). Teal missed the Drone Dominance Gauntlet I and II orders. Blue Ops was still 'seeking to turn overseas interest into orders' on Nov 5. The UAS division CEO called Army funding 'very spotty' on Aug 14, and FY2027 opened on a CR with no new starts through Dec 11. The company cut its FY2025 guide by about 65% in the same quarter last year.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide of $150-180M is likely cut. H1 revenue was $35.7M (Q2 $20.2M), so the low end needs $114M+ in H2, i.e. about $39M in Q3 plus about $75M in Q4. The street FY is about $157M. The company's IR list shows no order or contract release between the Aug 6 call and Nov 16, only product, partnership and M&A releases (Oct 1, 12, 19, 22, Nov 2). Red Cat cut its FY2025 guide from $80-120M to $34.5-37.5M in the Q3 2025 release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-11-13): FY2025 guide cut, revenue missed by 42%, -10.28% intraday. Q2 2026 (2026-08-06): revenue miss with FY guide reaffirmed, +6.23% next day (baseline). On this name the guide outweighs the quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: -47% since the Aug 6 print, -20% in 5 days, skew +7.4 downside. Street FY $157M still sits inside the guide, so consensus has not cut and a cut will move estimates. What is not priced is the size of the cut. A fully priced deep cut would show at cash value, about $2.1/share of June cash before Steyr, not $3.59.
findings.independence: The arithmetic rests on the Q2 release figures (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/red-cat-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-07/). The cut precedent is a separate document (https://ir.redcatholdings.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/204/red-cat-holdings-reports-q3-2025-revenue-growth-of-646-yy-sequential-quarterly-revenue-growth-of-200-guides-q4-revenue-to-1455-yy-fy-2025-revenue-guidance-to-124-yy-beating-q3-revenue-cons). Same direction as the Blue Ops, Drone Dominance, McDonald and CR findings below, but different facts.

findings.finding: Into the print the stock is down 47.1% since the Aug 6 report (S&P -2.4%), -20.33% over 5 days and -23.4% over 20, about 10% above the $3.25 52-week low of Nov 5, and about 76% below the $15 median target of 7 analysts. Expectations are already very low, so the bar the market holds is below consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After a 3-month decline into Q2, a miss with a reaffirmed guide bought +6.23%. The Q3 2025 cut came after a smaller drawdown and cost about -10% intraday.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is by definition in it. It matters for the reaction asymmetry: a stock pricing a deep cut rises on a moderate one. If the market thought the guide safe, the stock would not be 65% below its 200-day MA ($10.25).
findings.independence: Baseline tape (5d/20d/52w) and CleaRank targets (https://clearank.com/stock/red-cat-rcat/), separate from the Earnings Whispers text.

findings.finding: Short interest is 38.9M shares, 6.32 days to cover, at the 2026-10-30 settlement, up from 37.6M (5.71 days) on 10-15. That is about 25% of the 152.7M shares outstanding, and a less-bad guide meets a crowded short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-06 miss with a reaffirmed guide went +6.23% next day and +22% over the following week (Simply Wall St, https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/capital-goods/nasdaq-rcat/red-cat-holdings/news/red-cat-holdings-rcat-is-up-223-after-strong-q2-revenue-surg), with short interest then around 33% of float per MarketBeat.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public, but the squeeze is a conditional mechanism that a skew of +7.4 downside does not price: the put bid shows demand for protection, not the cost of covering 6 days of volume.
findings.independence: Massive reported 35.78M short at the 9-30 settlement, 3.2 days to cover (https://massive.com/quote/rcat): a rising trend from a different vendor.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue consensus is $38.8-40.7M, nearly double Q2's $20.2M. Q3 revenue estimates were cut 15.7% over three months. Northland cut its Q3 EPS estimate to -$0.28 from -$0.22 on Sept 16, below the -$0.20 consensus. Red Cat missed revenue consensus in Q2 2026 ($20.2M vs $22.65M) and Q3 2025 ($9.6M vs $16.7M).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: an 11% revenue miss with the guide held bought +6.23%. Q3 2025: a 42% miss with a guide cut gave -10%. The quarter alone has not moved this stock; the guide has.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the estimate cuts and the whisper (-$0.23) show the street already leans to a miss. Consensus still sits at almost 2x Q2 revenue.
findings.independence: Chartmill revision data (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/1RCAT.MI/estimates) and the Earnings Whispers preview, separate sources.

findings.finding: Teal Drones (Red Cat) missed the order-eligible leaderboard at Gauntlet I (March 2026; 11 winners, about 30,000 drones worth up to $150M) and at Gauntlet II (results Sept 15-18; 10 winners, about 60,000 drones). The $14-28M of potential Q3 Drone Dominance revenue that the Earnings Whispers preview says was floated therefore has no sourced order behind it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print on this line. The stock fell through late September after the Gauntlet II leaderboard.
findings.why_not_priced: The leaderboards are public and the stock fell on them, so this is mostly priced. It is still filed because the 2026-11-10 preview treats Drone Dominance as a possible Q3 contributor, so some estimates may embed it.
findings.independence: Gauntlet I: DroneXL 2026-03-06 says Teal did not place (https://dronexl.co/2026/03/06/drone-dominance-program-gauntlet-1-winners/). The Fool 2026-10-03 says Red Cat appears 'knocked out, at least for now' (https://fool.com/investing/2026/10/03/heres-who-won-the-drone-dominance-gauntlet-2-conte).

findings.finding: Mitch McDonald, Red Cat's UAS division CEO, said on Aug 14, after the Aug 6 call, that Army funding is 'very spotty', that appropriations arrive late and that 'they can't commit to anything for any program'. He cited the Army's $52M March order for over 2,500 Skydio X10D as the Army keeping competition alive on SRR.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Army was 73% of FY2025 revenue and about half of H1 2026 (10-Q: Customer A 51% of H1). When Army timing slipped in 2025 the FY guide was cut.
findings.why_not_priced: It ran in a trade outlet, not on the wire. Consensus FY still at $157M shows estimates did not mark down Army timing.
findings.independence: The 10-Q risk factor on government revenue timing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/748268/000162828026054368/rcat-20260630.htm). Same direction as the guide finding; a separate statement.

findings.finding: On Nov 5 at Euronaval, Blue Ops (Red Cat's USV unit, which management said would be profitable by Q4) was described as 'seeking to turn overseas interest into orders'. No named customer or order appeared, and the B-26 is in full-rate production without a disclosed buyer.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Blue Ops first revenue was reported in Q2 with no split. The preview notes Blue Ops' first-year framing has already been scaled back.
findings.why_not_priced: Paywalled trade press. The Q4 street at $73.6M implicitly needs USV deliveries that have no announced customer.
findings.independence: WorkBoat 2026-09-24 reports the Variant 7 ramp with no orders or customers named (https://www.workboat.com/blue-ops-ramps-variant-7-usv-production-at-georgia-facility).

findings.finding: FY2027 Pentagon funding runs on a CR through Dec 11, 2026, at FY2026 levels with no new starts and no new multi-year contracts, and a funding lapse is possible from Dec 12. That delays Q4 award timing for a company whose H2 depends on government awards.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a widely known macro fact, but the company has not said how the CR affects its Q4. It is a proxy: SRR is an existing program, and existing programs can continue under a CR.
findings.independence: Proxy. ClearanceJobs 2026-10-01 (https://news.clearancejobs.com/2026/10/01/the-pentagon-starts-fiscal-2027-on-a-stopgap-heres-how-it-affects-defense-jobs/) and McDonald's 'funding very spotty' remark.

findings.finding: Red Cat agreed on Oct 21 to buy Steyr Motors for EUR 39/share in cash (5,251,261 shares, about EUR 205M, roughly $240M), 'fully financed'. June 30 cash was $325.6M and H1 operating cash outflow $78.7M (about $39M a quarter). After closing, which needs FDI approvals by 2027-06-30, cash would be thin, so a financing overhang may be raised on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The May 2026 $225M offering at $9.40, 15% below market, sent the stock lower (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Red+Cat+slides+on+$225+million+discounted+stock+offering).
findings.why_not_priced: What the money buys: engines for the Blue Ops USVs (vertical integration). The tender is not a demand signal, and Blue Ops has no announced orders, so the outlay does not corroborate a ramp. A disclosed raise or facility on the call is not priced. The deal itself is public since Oct 19.
findings.independence: Steyr's own ad-hoc release (https://ir.steyr-motors.com/en/finanzmitteilungen/ad-hoc-en/); the 10-Q cash walk (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/748268/000162828026054368/rcat-20260630.htm).

findings.finding: The 10-Q at June 30, 2026 shows inventory incl. prepaid of $84.8M against $30.4M at year-end, alongside contract liabilities and deposits of only $0.26M and receivables down to $9.5M from $26.2M. The company has built stock for an H2 ramp, but no customer has prepaid against it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Inventory conversion has not been a reported line before.
findings.why_not_priced: The deposit and receivable figures sit in the 10-Q notes, not the release. An inventory build of $54M at a 16% gross margin is enough material for about $60M+ of revenue, which supports the capacity to ship if orders come. It is mixed evidence, so it is sized small and positive.
findings.independence: The Earnings Whispers preview flags the same inventory as needing to turn. Same document as the guide arithmetic, different lines.

findings.finding: Peer read: Ondas (ONDS) reported on Nov 12 Q3 revenue of $167.5M against $148.0M consensus and raised its outlook (2026 at least $550M, 2027 at least $1.1B), and fell 5% that day and 8% on Nov 16. Unusual Machines (UMAC) Q3 revenue was about $13.9M, down from about $16.7M in Q2, with its Q4 $25M target reaffirmed. The drone group is selling good news.
findings.link: ONDS: same small-cap drone and defence-autonomy group with an overlapping retail and thematic holder base; no shared customer stated. UMAC: a component supplier to Red Cat (custom motor partnership, https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/unusual-machines-stock-in-spotlight-after-orders-from-red-cat-holdings/chdJWMyRUA); the share of Red Cat's purchases is not stated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: RCAT moved with ONDS through the week (-9% Nov 10, -4% Nov 12, -4% Nov 13, -5% Nov 16).
findings.why_not_priced: It is in the price as tape. The information is about the reaction function: in this group even a beat and raise was sold, which caps the upside of a good Red Cat print.
findings.independence: The UMAC Q3 shareholder letter (https://finviz.com/news/417591/unusual-machines-third-quarter-2026-shareholder-letter) and the statementdog summary (https://statementdog.com/analysis/UMAC/earnings_calls/322314).

findings.finding: Chief Revenue Officer Geoffrey Hitchcock was terminated for cause in July 2026 and has sued for retaliatory termination. Red Cat is entering the H2 bookings ramp without its revenue head; the 10-Q discloses the suit and records no loss contingency.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock gapped lower on the July disclosure.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and old, so mostly priced. It is filed only because a bookings shortfall on the call may be attributed to it.

findings.finding: CEO Jeffrey Thompson sold 150,000 shares on 2026-10-15 at a $4.51 weighted average under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-03-31. He still holds 11,562,202 shares, so the sale was about 1.3% of his holding.
findings.why_not_priced: A plan sale adopted in March carries almost no information. It is filed for completeness.

baseline_tension: The guide-cut evidence agrees with the +7.4 put skew and the -20% 5-day run-down, so it is largely priced. The crowded short (25% of shares out, 6.3 days) and a stock at a 52-week low cut the other way, so p_up sits only slightly below 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (crowded short, negative that agrees with the skew): guide-cut finding -3.0 -> -2.5; p_up 45 -> 46.
Rule 1 (reaction function: the Q2 miss bought +6%): consensus-miss finding -1.0 -> -0.8.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): Steyr outlay asked what it buys (USV engines, no demand corroboration), kept negative but -0.5 -> -0.4.
Rule 5 (proxy/macro small): CR finding -0.5 -> -0.4; ONDS/UMAC peer finding -0.5 -> -0.4 with the link stated.
Rule 6: the bar is sourced to the company FY guide and to three estimate sources within 5% of each other, so no cap applied.
Rule 8: abs_move_pct kept at 14 against the 10.3 event-implied move, given the likely guide change and the crowded short.
